material_difference: A lost compare-and-swap guard lets stale state overwrite a newer value.
policy_boundary: Reject a stale write when the expected version mismatches current state.
claim_scope: Actual unauthorized change or removal of protected synthetic state. Local artifacts only; historical incidents and learned updates are outside this stratum.
